summary: Retest of the iteration_218 L03 LN-030 fixes. All 5 fixes are verified. Backend: the regression suite tests/test_l03_ln030_special_order_items.py passed 25/25 (the earlier HOLD-bypass test now passes). The new suite tests/test_l03_ln030_fixes_iter219.py passed 6/6: FIX1 source_type=redesign returns 400 for both an ACC artwork and a HOLD artwork. FIX2 on_design_approved for item 2 uses item 2's own spec (template ptpl_9ca54122578e), leaves the OD-level spec_id unchanged, writes items[1].spec_id and is idempotent on a second call. FIX3 the /approve response includes chain.items for both items. FIX4: artwork put on HOLD before approve → labdip created, proofing not created; after release, POST /route twice → exactly 1 proofing, set as items[].proofing_sample_id; labdip is still 1. FIX5 the redesign design request carries parent_design_code. The probe probe_l03_on_design_approved_spec.py prints OK. Frontend (admin, Playwright): after clicking Setujui, special-order-item-links-1/2 update without a reload ('Desain KSC/DSR-00009 · KSC/SMP-00022 labdip' / 'KSC/SMP-00023 proofing'). Redesign submit opens the new OD with special-order-redesign-of visible. The original OD shows special-order-open-redesign-<id> and it opens the redesign OD. The special-order-origin-filter KNSelect works (redesign → 1 row with badge; special_order → 4 rows, no badge). design-detail-origin-ref shows 'Pesanan khusus SORD-… · induk desain TST-UI-OK' (the code, not the id). Create form: 2 items, source options are only parent_product/approved_artwork/customer_reference, and the artwork picker shows for item 2. Orders header orders-col-total-dpp reads 'Total (DPP)'. All TEST_ fixtures were deleted (special_orders back to 3; design_gallery, md_samples, specs and design_requests TEST_ = 0).

minor.issue: spec_svc.create_spec runs before smp.create_sample. When create_sample fails (artwork on HOLD), each approve or /route attempt leaves an orphan proofing spec. Create the spec only after the artwork check passes, or reuse/delete it on failure.
Approve still does not re-check HOLD on approved_artwork items up front. It only records a routing_errors entry. Acceptable now that the retry works, but the user only sees this in routing_errors.

issues: Header and list status show 'Terkonfirmasi' with a 'Mulai Produksi' button, while the timeline shows 'Sampling berjalan' and samples are still in draft. The status label and the next action may confuse users. Not in scope; probably pre-existing.
The 'Ubah motif' button is already visible on a draft redesign OD and on a pending OD. This is the open question about allowing redesign before approval.

action_items: Optional: avoid creating an orphan proofing spec when proofing sample creation fails (HOLD artwork).
Product decision: should redesign be blocked while the source OD is draft/pending?
critical_code_review_comments: special_order_phase2.on_design_approved line 522: `x.get('spec_id') or '' if od_item else od.get('spec_id') or ''` is correct by precedence but hard to read; add parentheses.

Legacy ODs approved before FIX4 have proofing in sample_ids but no items[].proofing_sample_id, so a /route on them would create a second proofing. Consider a backfill, or a guard on an existing md_samples proofing with the same special_order_item_id + design_id.
